$comment: The values a consumer may set in its nen/workflow.json, nen/gates.json or nen/contract.json that a Hatsu skill reads and that either carry a canon default safe to write out or are needed by a skill, with the default its readers apply when it is absent. The maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-01 (docs/ROSTER.md § Rulings of 2026-10-01): the configuration files show every optionally settable value at its default, a fixed-set value carries a `$<key>` sibling listing its options, and a skill that needs a value nobody has set guides the maintainer through setting it instead of stopping. scripts/config_values.sh is the only reader: `diagnose` reports, `fill` writes the defaults and annotations (behaviour-neutral by construction), `need --skill <s>` lists what a phase cannot run without, `set` writes one chosen value. Each `default` is the one canon already states, cited in `source`, and `check-catalogue` holds it against docs/WORKFLOW.md's key tables. Two kinds of value are not listed, because writing a snapshot would stop it following its source: one derived at run time (iteration.lane from project.defaultLane, reports.timeZone from the host), and one whose default a reader resolves from a Hatsu canon file only when the key is absent (gates.json round_policy, sharingan § 6 and contracts/round_policy.default.json). NOT LISTED, each for a stated reason (a snapshot or a guess would change behaviour, or nen owns the key): values derived at run time (iteration.lane, reports.timeZone; profile.default, which nen derives from profile.allowed, is listed for its options and never given a default); values a reader resolves from a Hatsu canon file only when absent (gates round_policy.minRounds/.maxRounds); values nen also reads whose built-in default may differ from the skills' (commits.allowedAttributionTrailers, commits.forbiddenTrailers, commits.runTrailer, futon.advanceGo, gates round_policy.stallMinutes, gates version); structural blocks whose shape is the repository's own (models, reports.sections, gates delivery, dependabot_carve_out, check_exclusions, reviewer_fallback, default_approvers, base_reviewers); and nen/repos.json, nen/labels.json and the YAML files, which tenkai's other items own. Row fields: `kind` enum (a fixed set, `options` lists it) | subset (a list drawn from a fixed set, annotated `any of:`) | open (any value of its shape) | external (needs a step on an outside platform, `setup` names it) | secret-env (an environment-variable NAME, never the secret); `requiredBy` the skills that cannot run while it is unset; `ask` adoption (Tenkai asks for it) | on-use (only some repositories need it: Tenkai offers it, and the first skill in `requiredBy` to run asks then); `when` a <file>#<path> that must be non-empty for the row to apply; `candidatesFrom` a <file>#<path> whose keys are the picker's options; `nullIsAnswer` a null its readers treat as a deliberate answer (ask on each call), never outstanding; `choice: maintainer` a value WORKFLOW § 4 says is typed, never picked (row missing-maintainer-choice): candidates shown for reference, none starred; `nonProductionTarget` `set` refuses a target whose `why` does not read non-production; `landsByPR` a value that lands through its declaration PR before it runs, so the phase does not resume on it. `nen schema check` stays the authority on each file's validity; this catalogue is Hatsu's list of what Hatsu reads.

values.describe: The trunk: breath fast-forwards it, ao catches up from it, getsuga cuts from it, and the base-branch hook refuses a commit on it.
How breath names an effort's branch; {model} is the model alias, {persona} the roster persona, {descriptor} a short kebab phrase.
The declared verbs run on every turn: breath proves them on the fresh base, rasengan while authoring, kokusen before every commit. `lint` here is hatsu:gyo.
The project-wide suites kotoamatsukami runs at mukai when the change can affect them. An empty list is a statement that there is no suite.
Further declared suites (ui-test, an integration lane) kotoamatsukami may select when the change can affect them.
Percent line coverage of touched files under which byakugan stops at G5; the bar is never lowered by a run.
The middle rung of the coverage ladder byakugan reports against.
The top rung of the coverage ladder byakugan reports against.
What the ladder measures. `touched` is the only scope nen measures today; another is a G4 change plus a nen capability.
The project.launch target amaterasu starts at the end of a turn. null is an answer: with targets declared, each turn asks.
values.question: Which launch target should every turn start by default?

values.describe: The project.launch target amaterasu falls back to when the default's device is absent. null means it says so and stops.

The NON-PRODUCTION project.targets key an untargeted hatsu:kagutsuchi sends to. null is an answer: the target is typed on each call. A typed target always overrides it; a production target here is refused by `set` and by kagutsuchi.
values.question: Should an untargeted hatsu:kagutsuchi send to a standing non-production target? Typed, never picked: name one of the declared non-production targets, or keep null and type the target on each call.

What is kept: final-only keeps a dated file for the final readiness report alone; per-turn and landing reports are published, not retained.
The templates/<name>.html in the Hatsu plugin the turn report renders with.
Where visual evidence captures are written.
true makes mukai start hatsu:en on the PR it opened in the same turn; false makes it offer En and wait.

Seconds between En's quiet observations of a pending PR.
Which escalation rungs may fire, any subset of push, os and sound; an unlisted rung never fires.

What an ordinary turn rings: rung1 only, or every declared rung.
The ren profile a turn runs under when none is typed. Derived by nen from profile.allowed when absent, so fill annotates it and never writes a default.

values.describe: Which of fast, standard and thorough a typed profile may name; any other is refused with this list quoted.

A new target lands through its declaration PR at this repository's gate before it runs
